lines.en: The pelican wades slowly through the shallows.
Its great bill hangs against its breast.
Every step throws up water.
It waddles toward the shore.
Webbed feet print the sand.
It stops and looks down at the water.
Its bill nearly touches the surface.
It walks along the tide line.
Wings half open for balance.
It clumsily climbs onto a rock.
It turns to look out to sea.

lines.zh: 它拍了两下翅膀，又收起
lines.en: It flaps twice and folds.
It crosses a shallow flat.
Its throat pouch sways with its stride.

lines.zh: 它停在浪打不到的地方
lines.en: It stops beyond the reach of the surf.

lines.zh: 它低头整理胸前的羽毛
lines.en: It dips its head to tidy its breast.
The pelican stands, bill hanging low.
It tightens its throat pouch.

lines.zh: 我把喉囊搁在胸前，慢慢眨眼。
lines.en: I rest my pouch on my chest and blink slowly.

lines.zh: 海风吹动它背后的羽毛
lines.en: The sea wind stirs its back feathers.
It tucks one foot up.
It turns to look at a distant boat.

lines.zh: 它的喙轻轻开合了一下
lines.en: Its bill opens and closes slightly.
It turns its flank to the sun.
A feather blows loose.
It does not chase it, only watches.
It draws its neck down onto its shoulders.
Then it stretches its neck out.
It seems to have heard something.
And it relaxes again.
The pelican turns to face you.
A pale ring frames its eye.
It lifts its bill slightly.

lines.zh: 它歪头，看你手上的东西
lines.en: It tilts its head at your hands.
It takes two slow steps toward you.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，量你手里那条鱼。
lines.en: I tilt my head and size up the fish in your hand.
Its pouch jiggles.

lines.zh: 它低下头，喙几乎碰到你
lines.en: It lowers its bill almost to you.
It stands close and looks very large.

lines.zh: 它转身走开，去别处看海
lines.en: It turns away to watch the sea.
The pelican flaps away.
Its pouch jolts.
It pulls its bill back to its breast.
It walks a few steps askew.
A little blood shows on its feathers.
Its call comes out short and choked.
It retreats to the water's edge.
It stays in the water and will not come out.
Its breathing turns rapid.
Eventually it comes ashore again.

lines.zh: 鹈鹕朝你手里的鱼来了
lines.en: The pelican comes for the fish in your hand.
Its bill opens and the pouch stretches.
It scoops up fish and water together.
It squeezes the water out.

lines.zh: 鱼滑进喉咙，它仰了下头
lines.en: The fish slides down; it tips its head back.

lines.zh: 它低头看你还有没有鱼
lines.en: It looks down for another fish.
It follows you several steps.

lines.zh: 它在你旁边站定，很耐心
lines.en: It settles beside you, patient.
It puts its bill by your hand.

lines.zh: 吃到鱼它才满意地抖毛
lines.en: Fish eaten, it shakes its feathers.
The pelican sways at the bump.
Its bill nearly clips you.
It steps aside politely.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀扫过你的手臂
lines.en: A wing brushes your arm.
It backs two steps and stops.
It looks down at its own bill.

lines.zh: 我被你撞得偏了半步，没恼。
lines.en: You knocked me half a step off; I don't mind.

lines.zh: 脚蹼踩在你脚边的湿沙上
lines.en: Webbed feet press the wet sand by you.
It shows no reaction to you.
It carries on toward the water.

lines.zh: 两只鹈鹕并肩站在浅水
lines.en: Two pelicans stand in the shallows.

lines.zh: 它们的喙朝着同一个方向
lines.en: Their bills point the same way.

lines.zh: 一只把头靠在另一只背上
lines.en: One rests its head on the other's back.
They take turns preening.

lines.zh: 它们一起慢慢走进水里
lines.en: They walk into the water together.

lines.zh: 它们并排游着，动作很齐
lines.en: They swim abreast, in time.

lines.zh: 一只张翅，另一只跟着张
lines.en: One spreads its wings; the other follows.
Their pouches sway in unison.
They float quietly on the water.

lines.zh: 海把它们的影子拉得很长
lines.en: The sea stretches their shadows long.
The pelican scoops the fish up.
It squeezes out the water, keeping the fish.
It tips its head back to swallow.

lines.zh: 它对不是鱼的东西没兴趣
lines.en: Anything but fish it ignores.
It shakes the scraps from its bill.

lines.zh: 它低头找水里还有没有
lines.en: It scans the water for more.

lines.zh: 它把鱼含在喉囊里慢慢吞
lines.en: It holds the fish in its pouch.
Done, it lifts its head to you.
It flaps twice.
And waddles back to the water.
The pelican suddenly gapes its bill.

lines.zh: 我脚蹼一蹬，朝你的鱼篓过去。
lines.en: I push off with my webbed feet toward your fish basket.
Its pouch swells wide.

lines.zh: 我张了张喉囊，向你讨鱼。
lines.en: I open my pouch and beg you for a fish.

lines.zh: 它把脖子缩起来，准备动
lines.en: It draws its neck in, ready.
Its wings open halfway.
It fixes on your hand.
It circles you.
Its feet slap the water.

lines.zh: 它把你当成了喂食的人
lines.en: It has taken you for a feeder.
The pelican follows you along.
It reaches its bill out to test.
It stops right by your hand.
It waits, mouth open, for you to drop something.

lines.zh: 它等得不耐烦，踱了两步
lines.en: Tiring of waiting, it paces twice.
Then it returns to its spot.
It cocks its head at your pocket.

lines.zh: 它轻轻碰了一下你的手
lines.en: It nudges your hand.
It circles at your feet.
It is not in the least afraid.
The pelican clamps its bill on your hand.
Its heavy bill thumps your chest.
A wing beats your leg.
It grips your sleeve.
It shakes its head with real force.

lines.zh: 它夹空了一次，喙咔一声
lines.en: It snaps air; the bill clacks.
It backs off and stretches its neck.
It lumbers at you.

lines.zh: 它的脚蹼在你脚上踩了一下
lines.en: A webbed foot stamps your foot.
It retreats to the water after.

lines.zh: 水面那边来了个笨重的影子
lines.en: A heavy shape approaches over the water.
The pelican wades ashore.
It shakes the water off.

lines.zh: 它的大喙在阳光下很显眼
lines.en: That great bill stands out in the sun.
It stops on the sand and looks about.

lines.zh: 它慢慢朝有鱼的地方走
lines.en: It walks slowly toward where the fish are.

lines.zh: 它的脚蹼在沙上留了印
lines.en: Webbed prints stay in the sand.
It dips its bill into the water.
It scoops and lifts its head.
Its pouch bulges.
Singed feathers send it plunging into the water.

lines.zh: 落地时它的大喙先撞地
lines.en: It lands bill-first on the ground.
Underwater it paddles desperately.
The blast throws it onto the sand.
An arrow grazes its wing feathers.
Odd force makes it shudder.
Starving, it sways, bill dragging.

lines.zh: 雷击让它僵住，羽全立起
lines.en: Lightning locks it stiff, feathers up.

lines.zh: 虚空一拉，它扑腾着往下沉
lines.en: The void pulls; it beats its wings and sinks.
